meta.title: Lesson 1: My First Standup
meta.title_zh: 第 1 课：我的第一次站会

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先逐句听读一遍 · 再看中文讲解 · 最后完成英文小练习

segments.en: My name is Alex. Today is Monday, my first day at a new job. I am a new engineer. My team makes a chat program. In the morning, we have a short meeting. We call it a standup. Everyone stands and talks. I am a little nervous. It is my first time at a standup.
segments.tts: My name is Alex. Today is Monday, my first day at a new job. I am a new engineer. My team makes a chat program. In the morning, we have a short meeting. We call it a standup. Everyone stands and talks. I am a little nervous. It is my first time at a standup.
segments.zh: 我叫 Alex。今天是周一，新工作的第一天。我是新来的工程师，团队在做一个聊天程序。早上我们开个短会，叫站会。大家都站着说话。我有点紧张，这是我第一次参加站会。讲解：engineer=工程师，nervous=紧张的，first time=第一次。句形 my first day at a new job=新工作的第一天，have a meeting=开会。

segments.en: The team leader starts. He says hello and asks everyone to say one thing. I say: I am Alex, and I will learn the chat program today. My teammate Maria is kind. She says: welcome, Alex. She shows me where the code lives. I feel better now. The team is friendly.
segments.tts: The team leader starts. He says hello and asks everyone to say one thing. I say: I am Alex, and I will learn the chat program today. My teammate Maria is kind. She says: welcome, Alex. She shows me where the code lives. I feel better now. The team is friendly.
segments.zh: 组长先开口，问大家好，然后让每个人说一件事。我说：我叫 Alex，今天要学习聊天程序。队友 Maria 很友善，她说：欢迎你，Alex。她带我看代码放在哪里。我现在感觉好多了，团队很友好。讲解：leader=组长/领导，kind=友善的，welcome=欢迎，friendly=友好的。句形 say one thing=说一件事，show me where X lives=带我看 X 在哪。

segments.en: After the standup, I get my first task. My task is small: fix a small bug in the chat program. A bug is a small problem in the code. Maria tells me: take your time, ask questions. I open the code and look around. I find the problem. It is a small one. I can fix it today.
segments.tts: After the standup, I get my first task. My task is small: fix a small bug in the chat program. A bug is a small problem in the code. Maria tells me: take your time, ask questions. I open the code and look around. I find the problem. It is a small one. I can fix it today.
segments.zh: 站会后我接到第一个任务，任务很小：修复聊天程序里的一个小 bug。bug 就是代码里的小问题。Maria 说：慢慢来，有问题就问。我打开代码四处看看，找到了问题，是个小问题，今天就能修好。讲解：task=任务，take your time=慢慢来/别着急，look around=四处看看，fix=修复。句形 get my first task=接到第一个任务，find the problem=找到问题。

chunks.eg: We have a meeting every morning.
Today is my first day at work.
Please take your time with the task.
I look around the code first.

patterns.cn: 我叫 X。例如：My name is Alex.

patterns.t: Today is my first day at X.
patterns.cn: 今天是我在 X 的第一天。

patterns.t: A bug is a small problem in X.
patterns.cn: bug 就是 X 里的小问题。

transfer_tasks.task: Write 3 short sentences in English: say your name, what you did today, and what you will do tomorrow. Try to use have a meeting, take your time, and look around.
